name: The Secret Crane Princess Who Returns A Favor

texts.desc: During your opponent's End Phase: You can place this card from your GY on top of the Deck. During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can return this card from the field to the hand, and if you do, each player draws 1 card, then your opponent can draw 1 card, and if they do, you must keep your hand revealed during this Main Phase. (Quick Effect): You can banish this revealed card from your hand; destroy all face-up cards your opponent controls. You can only use each effect of "The Secret Crane Princess Who Returns A Favor" once per turn.
texts.name: The Secret Crane Princess Who Returns A Favor
